label: prop:co2-lp-dual-binding
title: LP dual selects linear $O{=}C{=}O$ geometry
html:
Proposition. LP dual selects linear O{=}C{=}O geometry

Proposition (conditional on conj:q-integer-mass-formula). The LP dual of the CO_2 molecular braid selects the symmetric linear arrangement O=C=O with two double bonds as the ground state. It minimises \Phi_1 over all possible:

  1. Bond order assignments: (k_1, k_2) with k_1 + k_2 \leq 4 (carbon's valence).
  2. Electron-bond assignments: which electrons are shared with which oxygen.
  3. Strand orderings: permutations of 66 strands.
